## Headers

- [Image.h](Image.h): Tightly packed 8-bit RGBA pixel storage (R,G,B,A per pixel). (declares `ImageData`, `ImageFormat`, `Image`)
- [ImageCodec.h](ImageCodec.h): umbrella header: includes 1 headers
- [ImageOps.h](ImageOps.h): A 2x3 affine matrix, row-major: [ m[0] m[1] m[2] ; m[3] m[4] m[5] ]. (declares `Affine2x3`, `resizeBilinear`, `warpAffineInverse`, `mirroredCrop`)
